brief.title: Recorded Heritage Exterior Demo
brief.script: [PUBLIC SAMPLE — ORIGINAL SCREENPLAY REDACTED] An adult photographer and adult guide cross a public heritage district at dusk. A small crew uses handheld equipment and battery-powered lighting. The recorded test included no drone, stunts, minors, animals, temporary structures, or road closure; permissions remained unconfirmed.

tasks.title: Check Rajasthan single window film clearance portal requirements
tasks.action: Check the Rajasthan Tourism Single Window Clearance System requirements, application lead time, and checklist for filming at or facing public monuments in the selected Rajasthan city.
tasks.rationale: Rajasthan Tourism operates a single window clearance mechanism coordinating across departments for film permissions.
tasks.needs_verification: Verify whether an exterior shoot staged from a public pavement facing the selected heritage landmark requires state archaeology permission, local police/traffic notification, or municipal clearance.

tasks.title: Clarify municipal and local police coordination pathway
tasks.action: Ask local authorities whether municipal and traffic police clearances are handled via the District Collector / Tourism portal or require direct local precinct intimation.
tasks.rationale: State tourism guidance notes that applicants need not apply separately to municipal corporations because clearances are coordinated via the administration.

citations.quote: There is no requirement of applying separately to Municipal Corporation. District Collector shall obtain necessary clearance
citations.title: Film Shooting Permission: Tourist Information Centre

tasks.needs_verification: Confirm the current operational procedure in the selected Rajasthan city for 2026, including whether traffic police must be notified directly regarding pavement presence along the selected public square during peak evening hours.

tasks.title: Assess India Cine Hub domestic versus state portal routing
tasks.action: Review whether this project should route its filming permission through the central India Cine Hub portal or apply directly to Rajasthan Tourism.
tasks.rationale: Central domestic project guidelines indicate state nodal officers process applications and local authorities may still need direct contact.

citations.quote: The application will be sent to the respective State Nodal officer/s, whose details will also be sent to you.
citations.title: Domestic Projects | India Cine Hub

tasks.needs_verification: Confirm whether the production qualifies as an Indian domestic project or foreign crew, and identify which single-window authority takes procedural precedence.

tasks.title: Prepare pedestrian flow and traffic buffer plan
tasks.action: Prepare a site safety plan establishing safe separation between the 8-person crew, pedestrian foot traffic on the pavement, and moving roadway traffic at the selected public square.
tasks.rationale: Planning suggestion: Dusk on the selected public square involves heavy vehicular traffic and pedestrian congestion immediately adjacent to public sidewalks.
tasks.needs_verification: Verify sidewalk width opposite the selected heritage landmark and evaluate whether physical spotters or high-visibility vests are mandated by local traffic police.

tasks.title: Evaluate camera support footprint on public pavement
tasks.action: Prepare a mobile footprint plan minimizing stationary gear, evaluating whether the tripod should be replaced with handheld or gimbal operation if sidewalk space is restricted.
tasks.rationale: Planning suggestion: Tripods and lighting stands create static obstruction hazards on busy urban sidewalks during evening rush hours.
tasks.needs_verification: Verify whether local public space regulations prohibit static ground support (tripods/light stands) without specific street obstruction permits.

questions: Is the production company registered in India, or is any international co-production or foreign crew member involved?
What exact pavement section opposite the selected heritage landmark is planned (e.g., street-level pavement or elevated rooftop/cafe frontage)?
Will battery-powered LED lights and reflectors be mounted on stationary stands or hand-carried by crew members?
What is the expected start and wrap time for the dusk exterior shoot on the recorded test date?
Will sound be recorded live on location, requiring crowd/traffic noise management?
Has a local line producer or fixer in the selected Rajasthan city been engaged to interface with the the selected Rajasthan city Traffic Police and Municipal Corporation?
